DesignOwnerRecord.document_owner: DocumentOwnerHandle (opaque M04 input capability, no DocumentSession value)
DesignOwnerRecord.writer_binding: trusted window nonce + generation (derived from M04)
DesignOwnerRecord.forbidden: No S1 constructor, content/history/baseline storage or independent authoritative registry

records.CandidateRecord: private request UUID, binding/session/generation/captured revision, immutable validated DesignDoc/canonical payload/semantic digest, unsupported list, source kind; never independently mutable SSOT
records.PreviewSession: private UUID, binding/session/generation/revision, consumer window nonce, expected_seq u64 initially1, immutable source snapshot, detached mock values, capabilities, active/stale state

owner_binding.identity: Reuse existing trusted bound project and explicitly adopted manifest document identity. No implicit WORK registration or new persistent UUID on load; absent/conflicting manifest binding -> MissingBinding/IdentityConflict and read-only diagnostic, no write. H2 does not change manifest schema or document adoption APIs.
owner_binding.owner_init: M04 open/attach returns DocumentOwnerHandle after native identity+C1/material checks. H2 never initializes S1. Missing integration => DependencyNotReady(M04_OWNER_INTEGRATION), zero facade-created sessions. M04 alone initializes exactly one existing S1 session.
owner_binding.S1_reuse: Only M04 document_owner.rs owns/mutates existing S1 DocumentSession. H2 holds opaque handle and immutable DTO projections. No direct constructor/edit/undo/baseline API in facade.
owner_binding.semantic_profile: SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1 exact common profile; payload preserves compatibility values; semantic omits exact approved paths only; no baseline relabeling.
owner_binding.mutation: Validate candidate→M05 Candidate pin→M04 one S1 Edit→complete live/history root transfer. Return MutationReceipt; AppliedRetentionDeferred reports real revision/Held, never ErrorUnchanged. Viewer selection/mock remains ephemeral.
owner_binding.unsupported: Read-only preserved projection, inert placeholders, unsupported ID/type list. No source-node filtering/stamping/Form insertion. Editing, save, and Viewer mock entry disabled while unsupported types/missing root Form exist. User must use a future explicit supported conversion workflow; no silent repair. Unknown scope labels remain data and grant no capabilities.
owner_binding.writer: Exactly one current writer: main or ui-editor instance. Viewer never writer. Current writer explicitly grants to an existing trusted ui-editor/main window nonce using design_binding_transfer; transfer increments generation, revokes candidates/preview sessions, preserves S1 content/history/revision. Transfer to missing/remote/viewer denied. Window destruction retires writer; replacement writer requires authenticated main claim with explicit confirmation, not matching label alone.
owner_binding.projection: All views receive raw validated canonical design_json plus revision/generation/dirty/can_edit/unsupported metadata. UI JSON.parse only after HOST C1 validation. A stale response cannot replace newer projection; rendering failure leaves old display with stale badge and authority remains HOST.
owner_binding.persistence: No new H2 filesystem-save path. design_document_save returns DependencyNotReady(M04_S2) until an approved M04 persistence input seam is wired in a separately reviewed integration slice. Legacy uidesign_save_design/load_design/build_preview handlers fail closed with DESIGN_OWNER_REQUIRED for authoritative owner operations; no typed/raw root bypass. Existing exported communication preview remains explicitly non-authoritative; it is not upgraded to trusted Viewer IPC in this slice.
owner_binding.boundaries: Session/runtime teardown loses unsaved state only after explicit discard confirmation; this H2 proposal adds no autosave/recovery store. M04/M07 integration readiness remains separate; owner emits completed mutation observations only, never claims snapshot persistence.
owner_binding.request_records: All commands carrying request_id use runtime key(binding_ref,session_uuid,operation,request_id) with immutable typed capture. Validate caller first, then same-ID identical capture returns retained original terminal result with replayed=true and no extra commit/undo/save; different capture RequestConflict. Matching in-flight request Busy. Capture revision checked for new requests, never use a repeated request to mutate newer revision. New request_id with used candidate -> CandidateUsed. Retain until owner closed, at128 keys per binding/1024 runtime refuse before reservation, no eviction/time-based retry. No durable exactly-once across restart. Close/revoke removes replay authority; late response never installs over newer projection.
owner_binding.open_dependency: design_binding_open must use an approved M04 owner-open input dependency to obtain identity-bound validated snapshot/baselines. Until that dependency exists return DependencyNotReady(M04_OWNER_INTEGRATION), no direct legacy load or invented initial content. Test doubles supply immutable approved-shaped snapshots in RED/component tests; they are not native integration proof.
owner_binding.owner: M04 document_owner.rs owns exactly one S1 DocumentSession per project/document; design_owner.rs facade only, no initializer/registry duplication.

architecture.hexagonal: UI/Tauri closed input → M03 facade → M04 DocumentOwner input → existing S1; M04 → C1/material output abstractions; adapters implement Ports.
architecture.dependency: M03 depends M04 input abstractions+immutable DTO only; no M04 callback to M03 runtime for material resolution.
architecture.state_owner: M04 owns one S1 session; M03 owns derived candidate/viewer ephemeral records only.
architecture.transaction: M03 prepare candidate → M04 validate/recheck → M05 durable pin → M04 one S1 Edit/Undo → M05 roots → mutation result/deferred.
architecture.forbidden: No UI FS, facade S1 constructor/mutation, second registry, private journal or Viewer generic dispatch.

lifecycle.writer_transfer: Common owner transfer increments shared generation and invalidates all module plans bound to old generation; content/history/revision unchanged, pins/proofs retained.

replay_protocol.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
replay_protocol.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
replay_protocol.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.

request_digest.algorithm: SHA256 of canonical UTF8 of ENTIRE validated request value, including body recursively. No field projection, ignored fields, defaults or post-hash enrichment. Authentication resolves every opaque handle before frozen body assembly. Server resolved identity/content/evidence fields shown in schema are mandatory.
canonicalization: Reject duplicates before object construction; unknown/missing/null outside declared union reject before replay lookup and IO.
Object names sorted by UTF8 bytes. All scalar text valid Unicode scalar values; no normalization.

Strings: quote and backslash escaped, backspace/tab/newline/formfeed/carriage-return as \b/\t/\n/\f/\r; remaining U+0000..001F as lowercase \u00xx; other scalars literal UTF8; no slash escaping/BOM/whitespace.
All integers U64Decimal strings checked in range. No numeric JSON tokens in transition hash schema.
Arrays preserve admitted order, including resolve requests, entries, aliases, roots, evidence and assets. Order changes conflict; do not sort/deduplicate after hashing.

Same key and valid changed body => ReplayConflict before IO; exact same bytes replay retained receipt. Invalid body => InvalidRequest before key lookup. SHA collision resistance assumed, not proved by vectors.
request_digest.excluded: Transport correlation, UI display strings outside declared operation, transient read handles and secrets are not request inputs. Any new behavior-affecting input requires schema/replan; cannot silently exclude.
request_digest.generated_outputs: Pin id created by pin/import is OUTPUT, never caller input. Existing pin_id mandatory for transfer/release. Selection handles freeze full native identity/raw digest/metadata before hash; bundle entries include all admitted metadata and alias mapping.
request_digest.read_only_calls: validate_pin/read_pinned_version/register_roots do not use transition receipt key; authorization and bounds still apply. Provider registration lifecycle unchanged.

replay_protocol.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
replay_protocol.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
replay_protocol.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

issuer_proof_records.schema: SGA-MATERIAL-RECEIPT-v1 (new catalog index transition_receipts record; pending schema adoption)

fields.result: Tagged terminal Pin|Imported|Transferred|Released; no runtime DocumentMutation success here

issuer_proof_records.atomicity: Record and pin/root transition in same catalog raw commit. Logical catalog_generation/target_identity verify inclusion without circular embedding of own raw digest. External raw CommitReceipt kept as issuer evidence, not hashed into the same committed bytes.
issuer_proof_records.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.
issuer_proof_records.retention: No receipt eviction or pin timeout in this slice. Input/index limits from M05 remain; full index => CapacityExceeded before mutation; compaction/GC separate proposal.

external_issuers.M04: FormalSaveProof requires IO receipt+M05 transfer+captured semantic ACK; runtime owner replay loss => UnverifiedOutcome unless all issuer evidence actually revalidated. MutationReceipt runtime only.
external_issuers.M07: Immutable attempt/payload/index receipt; LocalIntegrityReady independent source ACK.
external_issuers.M01: final path Ready marker and matching digests; not inherited source approval.
